G1_unambiguity.justification: The statement clearly defines an undirected network and requires paths between every consecutive pair of distinct core banks.

G2_completeness.justification: It includes all relevant constraints, input formats, feasibility guarantees, cost rules, output requirements, and the single-core edge case.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Requiring paths between consecutive core banks is equivalent in an undirected graph to requiring all core banks to lie in one connected component, so the optimization task is unchanged.

G4_naturalness.justification: The memory-synchronization framing reads naturally overall, though describing the core banks as an ordered sequence is somewhat unnecessary for an inherently unordered connectivity condition.
